values.note: Jackson County Parks 2026 fees (one table for its campgrounds): modern site with 30-amp service $38 a night for non-county residents, 50-amp $43. Jackson County residents pay $5 less ($33 / $38). Ten-day notice for refunds, none for weather; $20 processing fee. Read 2026-10-25.

fees.source: https://www.mijackson.org/DocumentCenter/View/22677/Camping-Fees-2026-Season?bidId= ('Non-County Resident Modern Site (30 amp service) ... $38.00', 'Non-County Resident Modern Site (50 amp service) ... $43.00', 'County Resident Modern Site (30 amp service) ... $33.00'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://www.mijackson.org/Facility/Details/Pleasant-Lake-County-Park-Campground-19 ('60 modern campsites are available with water and electricity'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Reservations open January 2, online through Jackson County's WebTrac or by phone at (517) 788-4320. No more than 10 consecutive nights; a new permit after 24 hours. Check-in 1 pm, check-out 11 am.

booking.source: https://www.mijackson.org/Facility/Details/Pleasant-Lake-County-Park-Campground-19 ('Reservations open the 2nd of January. Online reservations can be made here: https://mijacksoncountyweb.myvscloud.com/webtrac/web/ Or, call our office at (517) 788-4320'; 'Campers are not permitted to camp for more than 10 consecutive nights') + fee sheet ('Maximum 10 Nights'), read 2026-10-25

note: Jackson County Parks & Rec campground at Pleasant Lake, 21 acres under mature trees; sandy swim beach, public boat launch nearby. --Claude
summary: Read the county's facility page and 2026 fee sheet. Changed fees $33-43 (resident base) -> $38-43, the non-county-resident rate as base per the local rule (residents $5 less, in fees.note). Confirmed 60 modern sites with water and electric, free dump for campers, WebTrac booking opening Jan 2, 10-night max (url added). Not on these pages: the 50-amp at THIS park (the fee table is county-wide; electric 50 left as derived), showers, season dates. Note trimmed of what the fields hold and the RV Life remark.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: the county says the campground is 'Positioned on the lake shore' of Pleasant Lake ('Go for a swim off the sandy beach'); the entry has 'not waterfront'.

Phone: the entry's 517-788-4320 is the Jackson County Parks office (the page's booking number); the fee sheet gives the campground itself as 517-769-6401 (4001 Styles Road; the facility page says 4401 Styles Road).
